title: GAEB-Angebot im Browser: X83-Leistungsverzeichnis bepreisen und als X84 abgeben
pitch: For small trades (painters, electricians, roofers, landscapers) who get a GAEB X83 bill of quantities with a public tender and must return a priced X84 file: open, price and export in the browser, on any computer, with the file never leaving the device. If it takes off it becomes the bidding companion next to tender-notice pages (Formblatt 221/223, X89 invoices, Austrian ONLV).

evidence.note: Comparison of 9 GAEB tools with prices: GAEB-Online 120/180 EUR (Windows 10/11), Wingaebxml Bietertool 125-600 EUR (X83/X84 explicit), T&T 99-2,499 EUR, DanglIT WebGAEB free in the browser with a single download. Undated page, (c) 2026; accessed.
10 autocomplete variants: x84 datei, in x83 umwandeln, in excel umwandeln, öffnen, einlesen, konverter, x83 x84
Search result seen (not opened): mein.gaeb-365.online, a GAEB tool for trades that also handles Formblatt 221

competitors.name: Wingaebxml Bietertool
competitors.gap: Desktop licence 125-600 EUR one-off; OS not stated; overkill for occasional bidders

competitors.name: GAEB-Online 2025
competitors.gap: Windows 10/11 only, 120 EUR one-off; X84 not named in the comparison

competitors.name: T&T Datentechnik GAEB-Konverter
competitors.gap: Package pricing from 99 EUR up to 2,499 EUR; OS not stated

competitors.name: DanglIT WebGAEB
competitors.gap: Free browser converter, but download possible only once and pricing an X84 is not confirmed

competitors.name: Trade software suites (e.g. STREIT)
competitors.gap: Full ERP with prices on request; too much for a few tenders a year

window: Standing gap. The paid tools are Windows desktop programs sold as one-off licences (GAEB-Online needs Windows 10/11), and the free web converter allows one download and does not say it can price an X84. Nothing hosted is aimed at a trade that bids a few times a year.
monetizationIdea: Small trades pay 89 EUR a year (or 12 EUR per tender) to price and export schema-valid X84 bids without buying a Windows desktop licence.

money.payer: A construction trade business with 1-20 staff that bids on public tenders a few times a year and has no AVA software with GAEB
money.buys: A schema-valid X84 file the client's AVA software accepts, without retyping hundreds of positions or buying a 120-600 EUR licence. An invalid or missing data file can weaken or disqualify a bid.
money.price: 89 EUR a year, or 12 EUR per exported tender

proof.note: Bidders pay 120 EUR (GAEB-Online), 125-600 EUR (Wingaebxml, X83/X84) or 99 EUR+ (T&T) for this job

money.nobodyPaysIf: The free WebGAEB or a trial of a trade suite already lets them enter prices and export X84, or the trade does so few tenders that a one-off desktop licence is cheaper over three years.

risks: The GAEB schema documentation may need registration with the GAEB body; check before building
A wrongly exported bid would cause angry users: validate against the official schema and show a summary before export
edge: Works in any browser (Mac, Linux, tablet) with no install or sign-up, and the file never leaves the device. GAEB-Online needs Windows 10/11 (STREIT comparison), and WebGAEB allows one download and does not state X84 pricing.
